findings.message: The mandatory platform fee is still a proposal architecture discussion and is not prototype-ready.
findings.remediation: Integrate the non-bypassable canonical-pool hook path, bind its evidence, and then set status to implemented.

findings.message: Review-framing decision for maintainers: should an already-deployed, immutable, ownerless hook enter the beta as a flagship reference record (architecture review of a live artifact) rather than as a launch application, and which central result label do maintainers prefer for that state?
findings.remediation: Resolve the decision, update the locked design and rerun preflight.

findings.message: programmableFee scope decision for maintainers: the deployed instance cannot integrate the volume-fee policy, so is a future Programmable-launch variant (a new deployment integrating the fee into its single custom hook) in scope for this application id, or would that be a separate application?
findings.remediation: Resolve the decision, update the locked design and rerun preflight.

findings.message: Project category onchain-generative-art is not a closed launch-type decision and requires architecture review of its declared behavior.
findings.remediation: Keep the category and describe the actors, value flows, authorities, failures and integration surfaces; do not force the project into an unrelated known profile.

findings.message: Novel token behavior transfer-coupled-nft-dormancy-sync remains reviewable outside the acceleration catalog.
findings.remediation: Review its exact authority, value, supply, transfer, provider, failure and test boundaries without forcing it into a known behavior.

requiredGates.reason: Automation cannot accept its own output.
A value-moving project surface needs independent accounting, authorization and economic review.
Every model needs an independent review scaled to its capability and value risk before selection.
Feature trigger: custom-math.
A model-specific baseline changes the architecture and trust assumptions outside the Programmable-tested acceleration path.
A builder-pinned compiler and dependency closure remains unreviewed until maintainers verify the exact lock and source graph.
The project uses a novel category that must be reviewed by behavior rather than rejected by label.
At least one token behavior is outside the current acceleration catalog.
Every candidate must prove compatibility with exact deployments and current chain state.
A proposal may discuss a pending hook integration, but it cannot become a Programmable prototype without the mandatory volume fee.
Routing or listing is controlled by each external provider.
External routers, quoters, indexers, scanners and listings control their own support decisions.
Published Uniswap routing-review criteria apply; only the provider can approve the hook or pool.
Every hook must authenticate PoolManager and match its mined address permissions.
Every enabled callback must return the exact selector and ABI length and account for noSelfCall suppression.
The model has external dependencies.
Liquidity callbacks expose feesAccrued and may be sensitive to just-in-time liquidity ordering.
Every prototype must pass its declared language build and size checks without unexplained warnings.
Novel token behavior needs bound authority, accounting, liveness and failure tests.
A project surface can move, award, claim, fee or settle value.
Declared Solidity source needs static findings with dispositions.
Declared Solidity behavior needs lifecycle and property evidence.
High-risk models need a second independent review before a production release decision.
Availability requires operational evidence after deployment.
High-risk models need live accounting, callback and authority anomaly monitoring.
A released value-moving surface needs live conservation, payout and failed-settlement monitoring.
High-risk models need a funded public vulnerability disclosure path before availability.
Deployment claims require runtime, source and configuration evidence.

disclaimer: This is a structural and rule-based compatibility preflight. Free-text claims still require independent semantic review. PROTOTYPE_READY means only that an isolated prototype may begin; it is not acceptance, an audit, a safety guarantee, deployment evidence, routing approval or proof of availability.
